headline: 2027 BMW iX5 offers 450 miles of range, fast charging
summary: Reviewers tested the new 2027 BMW iX5 electric SUV, both highlighting roughly 450 miles of range and fast charging, with one noting the EV's doors can close themselves.

claims.statement: The 2027 BMW iX5 offers about 450 miles of range on a charge.

sources.quote: will do over 450 miles on a charge
450 miles of range are among the reasons

claims.statement: The iX5 can close its own doors.
BMW is offering the new X5 in both gas and electric (iX5) versions.

sources.quote: BMW goes both ways with new 2027 X5 and iX5
